checks: Item uses actual recipient and typed U64 Gwei with no validator-only discriminator. amount_exact proves multiplication fits UInt256 before removing modulo; amount_bounded derives the exact existing envelope maximum.

GuardedAdds records every append and its cumulative prior count. guarded_length derives final combined length, including empty-list prior bound; skipped reference iterations are not claimed to be simulated.

gloasPayload retains all four supplied lists in order: builder pending, validator partial, builder sweep, validator sweep. Final guard relation includes prior lengths of all preceding lists and proves total<=16 even with empty validator sweep. Earlier guard premises are explicit stage-validity inputs, not silently proved Python loop behavior.

Payload carries per-list bound<=16 and Fin(2^64) beacon slot. total_count uses Nodup slot cardinality and sum of each list length; no block-number width or withdrawal-index wrap bound appears. Duplicate-valued entries and recipients are not deduplicated.

Dispatch threads literal increaseBalance for every item through exact worlds in list order. dispatch_ledger inducts that relation, derives one Ledger.withdrawal increment per item and sums actual amount.toNat; only amount bound is derived from Item type. No assumed dispatched count or post-world wealth equation.

dispatched_counts binds exact flattened payload items to Dispatch, converts flattened length to totalItems and populates Counts with the same ledger count. Initial withdrawal index is explicitly zero for this specialized consecutive-dispatch theorem; dispatch_ledger permits nonzero prior counts and interleaved outer chronology.
